text:
lee: Weekend check-in — whos up for something low-key? Options: (1) sunrise coffee run + farmers market, (2) home movie night (Ill stream something goofy), or (3) trail cleanup volunteer shift at 10am.

tasha: Farmers market sounds perfect. I can bring a tote and cash. :leaves:

owen: Movie night for me. Got a new projector and fuzzy blankets. Will bring popcorn.

riley: Im free Saturday morning so Ill do the trail cleanup. Might be muddy though.

kevin: Farmers market if its sunny, otherwise movie night. Also: any veg options? I can bring hummus + pita.

lee: Plan: final call 8am Saturday. If weather good -> meet at market 9am. If drizzle -> movie at my place 7pm. Trail cleanup if 4 or more people volunteer.

tasha: RSVP: market.

owen: RSVP: movie.

riley: RSVP: cleanup.

kevin: RSVP: market (with hummus).

lee: Cool. Will post address and movie poll Saturday morning. :thumbsup:
